description: This Java class 'ColorManager' assigns colors to tasks and activities within an Android application, managing color mappings and providing methods to retrieve colors based on activity components or task IDs.

classes.name: ColorManager
classes.description: Manages color assignments for activities and tasks, providing static methods to get colors based on activity components or task IDs.

methods.name: getColorForActivity
methods.description: Returns the color assigned to a specific activity, creating a new assignment if none exists.

methods.name: getColorForTask
methods.description: Returns the color assigned to a specific task ID, creating a new assignment if none exists.

methods.name: nextTaskColor
methods.description: Selects the next color for task assignment from the color array.

methods.name: nextActivityColor
methods.description: Selects the next color for activity assignment from the color array.
